title: CROSSFILTER NONE stops a relationship from propagating filters
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "Blue", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ), Product[Color] = "Blue" ), "BlueNone", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Sales[Quantity] ), Product[Color] = "Blue", CROSSFILTER ( Sales[SKU], Product[SKU], NONE ) ) )

source.quote: Modifies the relationship cross filter direction (to one or both), or it disables filter propagation (none)
source.supports: CROSSFILTER with none disables filter propagation

source.quote: the cross-filter direction, which can be BOTH, ONEWAY, NONE
source.supports: NONE is one of the three directions

derivation: Blue products are Jeans (CL-02) and Hat (AC-01). With the relationship: Sales row 2 = 20. With CROSSFILTER NONE the Product filter does not reach Sales: all rows = 10 + 20 + 30 = 60. SUM of a whole number column is a whole number.
